changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingpaymenttransaction AS SELECT bpt.id, bpt.transaction_number, bpt.payment_id, bpt.parent_transaction_id, bpt.transaction_type, bpt.payment_method_id, bpt.payment_method_code, bpt.amount, bpt.currency, bpt.status, bpt.transaction_date, bpt.external_reference, bpt.authorization_code, bpt.processor_reference, bpt.card_last_four, bpt.bank_reference, bpt.cash_register_id, bpt.failure_code, bpt.failure_reason, bpt.processor_response, bpt.idempotency_key, bpt.notes, bpt.created_by, bpt.created_date, bpt.last_modified_by, bpt.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_payment_transaction bpt;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpaymenttransaction TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpaymenttransaction FROM report_user;
